description.value: Crust Bakery is an award-winning, female-owned French-inspired bakery and pastry shop that has been a downtown Victoria institution since 2013. Made-from-scratch breads, tarts, pastries, savoury snacks, and fresh Caffe Umbria espresso draw long lines of locals and visitors alike. A second location also operates at the Uptown Mall; the Fort Street shop is the original and sits within easy reach of Victoria's inner harbour cycling routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the OSM contact details (phone, address, website). The site describes Crust as an award-winning bakery selling French-inspired pastries, breads, and baked goods with a coffee bar, open daily — a viable food stop for touring cyclists in downtown Victoria. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM record covers only the Fort Street location; a second Crust Bakery location exists at 3535 Uptown Blvd, Victoria (Uptown Mall) and may warrant a separate OSM/directory entry.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating downtown Victoria bakery with strong food and coffee offerings — a natural resupply and rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the city core.
